_why: The chairman's CI-health targets (2026-10-03, #928, row #3212) as DATA. scripts/ci-health.mjs reads this file and holds no second copy, so changing a target is a one-line edit here and the weekly table's Target column changes with it. A target is atLeast, atMost or below; unit is ratio (printed as a percentage), count or dollars. readBy names the row that measures a target this reader does not, which the table prints as 'not read here' rather than leaving the target out.
